no_code_path: internal/plugins/isis/spf/leak.go LeakPrefixes builds IntoL1 only from the Level 2 result and IntoL2 only from the Level 1 result (leakInto with setDownBit true or false); no other producer re-advertises a prefix between areas at one level, so no same-level inter-area advertisement reaches TLV 135.
note: The condition, a prefix advertised from one area to another at the same level, never arises in Ze.
